query: SELECT id FROM candidate WHERE crawl_id = ?1 AND (id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM candidate_profile WHERE crawl_id = ?1 AND url IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?2))) OR (name = ?3 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(emails) a JOIN json_each(?4) b ON a.value = b.value COLLATE NOCASE))) ORDER BY id
